scientific_integrity: The numerical sharp bound and optimizer descriptions follow from an algebraic all-dimensional proof; finite-field exact checks independently corroborate examples and ranks. Scientific originality has residual bibliography risk. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to positive-definite functions on finite binary vector groups with Hamming support radius at most three and counting measure. All optimizers are classified in odd dimensions; only the radial family is classified in even dimensions. Does not compute coding-packing optima or address larger balls.
title: Sharp Turán mass and optimizer geometry of radius-three Boolean Hamming balls
